/-- The suffix consumes a completed accumulator and the selected row's bias/output pointers. -/
structure SuffixEntry (ops : FP32.Arithmetic) (data : TensorData layout rows)
    (buffers : Buffers) (i : Fin rows) (initial : State Register) (start : Nat := 0) : Prop where
  pc : initial.pc = start
  active : initial.returned = false
  accumulator : initial.regs .accumulator = prefixAccumulator ops data i layout.inputWidth
  biasRead : initial.regs64 .biasRead = elementAddress buffers .bias i.val
  biasStored : initial.globalMemory (elementAddress buffers .bias i.val) = some (data.bias i)
  outputWrite : initial.regs64 .outputWrite = elementAddress buffers .output i.val

private def finalState (ops : FP32.Arithmetic) (s : State Register) (bias : Word32) : State Register :=
  let s := s.write .biasValue bias
  let s := s.write .accumulator (ops.addRN (s.regs .accumulator) (s.regs .biasValue))
  let s := s.write .result (FP32.maxPositiveZero (s.regs .accumulator))
  let s : State Register := { s with
    globalMemory := fun a => if a = s.regs64 .outputWrite then some (s.regs .result) else s.globalMemory a
    pc := s.pc + 1 }
  { s with returned := true, pc := s.pc + 1 }

/-- Return with the specified stored result and all unrelated memory/register values preserved. -/
structure SuffixResult (ops : FP32.Arithmetic) (data : TensorData layout rows)
    (buffers : Buffers) (i : Fin rows) (initial final : State Register) (start : Nat := 0) : Prop where
  pc : final.pc = start + reluSuffix.length
  returned : final.returned = true
  bias : final.regs .biasValue = data.bias i
  accumulator : final.regs .accumulator =
    ops.addRN (prefixAccumulator ops data i layout.inputWidth) (data.bias i)
  result : final.regs .result = rowResult ops data i
  memory : OutputStored ops data buffers i initial.globalMemory final.globalMemory
  other32 : ∀ r, r ≠ .biasValue → r ≠ .accumulator → r ≠ .result → final.regs r = initial.regs r
  regs64 : final.regs64 = initial.regs64
  predicates : final.predicates = initial.predicates

/-- The same suffix theorem at its actual offset after any instruction prefix. -/
theorem reluSuffix_correct_at (prelude : List (Instruction Register)) (ops : FP32.Arithmetic) (data : TensorData layout rows)
    (buffers : Buffers) (i : Fin rows) (initial : State Register) (id : Identity)
    (env : Environment) (hentry : SuffixEntry ops data buffers i initial prelude.length) :
    ∃ final, run (prelude ++ reluSuffix) id reluSuffix.length initial env (some ops) = some final ∧
      SuffixResult ops data buffers i initial final prelude.length := by
  have hb : initial.globalMemory (initial.regs64 .biasRead) = some (data.bias i) := by
    rw [hentry.biasRead]; exact hentry.biasStored
  have hoff (j : Nat) : ¬ prelude.length + j < prelude.length := by omega
  refine ⟨finalState ops initial (data.bias i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [run, step, reluSuffix, Instruction.execute, Operand.read, Operand64.read,
      State.write, finalState, hentry.pc, hentry.active, hb, List.getElem?_append, Nat.add_assoc, hoff]
  · constructor
    · simp [finalState, State.write, reluSuffix, hentry.pc, Nat.add_assoc]
    · rfl
    · simp [finalState, State.write]
    · simp [finalState, State.write, hentry.accumulator]
    · simp [finalState, State.write, rowResult, hentry.accumulator]
    · constructor
      · simp [finalState, State.write, hentry.outputWrite, hentry.accumulator, rowResult]
      · intro address h
        simp [finalState, State.write, hentry.outputWrite, h]
    · intro r hb ha hr; simp [finalState, State.write, hb, ha, hr]
    · rfl
    · rfl

/-- Execute the suffix independently at fragment-relative PC zero. -/
theorem reluSuffix_correct (ops : FP32.Arithmetic) (data : TensorData layout rows)
    (buffers : Buffers) (i : Fin rows) (initial : State Register) (id : Identity)
    (env : Environment) (hentry : SuffixEntry ops data buffers i initial) :
    ∃ final, run reluSuffix id reluSuffix.length initial env (some ops) = some final ∧
      SuffixResult ops data buffers i initial final := by
  simpa using reluSuffix_correct_at [] ops data buffers i initial id env hentry

/-- One thread's private registers/PC, together with the shared global-memory snapshot. -/
structure State (Reg : Type) where
  regs : Reg → Word32
  pc : Nat
  regs64 : Reg → Word64
  globalMemory : GlobalMemory
  predicates : Reg → Bool := fun _ => false
  returned : Bool := false

inductive Operand (Reg : Type) where
  | reg (name : Reg)
  | imm (value : Word32)
  | tidX
  | ctaidX

def Operand.read (id : Identity) (s : State Reg) : Operand Reg → Word32
  | .reg r => s.regs r
  | .imm v => v
  | .tidX => id.tidX
  | .ctaidX => id.ctaidX

inductive Operand64 (Reg : Type) where
  | reg (name : Reg)
  | imm (value : Word64)

def Operand64.read (s : State Reg) : Operand64 Reg → Word64
  | .reg r => s.regs64 r
  | .imm v => v

/-- Selected instruction forms needed by the scalar dense-ReLU kernel. -/
inductive Instruction (Reg : Type) where
  | mov (dst : Reg) (src : Operand Reg)
  | madLo (dst : Reg) (a b c : Operand Reg)
  | mulWide (dst : Reg) (a b : Operand Reg)
  | add64 (dst : Reg) (a b : Operand64 Reg)
  | ldParam64 (dst : Reg) (symbol : String)
  | cvtaGlobal64 (dst : Reg) (src : Operand64 Reg)
  | movF32 (dst : Reg) (value : Word32)
  | loadF32 (dst : Reg) (address : Operand64 Reg)
  | fmaRN (dst : Reg) (a b c : Operand Reg)
  | add32 (dst : Reg) (a b : Operand Reg)
  | setpLt (dst : Reg) (a b : Operand Reg)
  | branchIf (predicate : Reg) (target : Nat)
  | addF32RN (dst : Reg) (a b : Operand Reg)
  | maxPositiveZero (dst : Reg) (src : Operand Reg)
  | storeF32 (address : Operand64 Reg) (src : Operand Reg)
  | ret

def State.write [DecidableEq Reg] (s : State Reg) (dst : Reg) (v : Word32) : State Reg :=
  { s with regs := fun r => if r = dst then v else s.regs r, pc := s.pc + 1 }

def State.write64 [DecidableEq Reg] (s : State Reg) (dst : Reg) (v : Word64) : State Reg :=
  { s with regs64 := fun r => if r = dst then v else s.regs64 r, pc := s.pc + 1 }

/-- All operands are read before the destination is updated. BitVec arithmetic wraps. -/
def Instruction.execute [DecidableEq Reg] (id : Identity) (s : State Reg)
    (inst : Instruction Reg) (env : Environment := Environment.empty)
    (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic := none) : Option (State Reg) :=
  match inst with
  | .mov dst src => some (s.write dst (src.read id s))
  | .madLo dst a b c => some (s.write dst (a.read id s * b.read id s + c.read id s))
  | .mulWide dst a b => some (s.write64 dst (wideProduct (a.read id s) (b.read id s)))
  | .add64 dst a b => some (s.write64 dst (a.read s + b.read s))
  | .ldParam64 dst symbol => (env.params symbol).map (s.write64 dst)
  | .cvtaGlobal64 dst src => (env.space.toGlobal (src.read s)).map (s.write64 dst)
  | .movF32 dst value => some (s.write dst value)
  | .loadF32 dst address => (s.globalMemory (address.read s)).map (s.write dst)
  | .fmaRN dst a b c => ops.map (fun op =>
      s.write dst (op.fmaRN (a.read id s) (b.read id s) (c.read id s)))
  | .add32 dst a b => some (s.write dst (a.read id s + b.read id s))
  | .setpLt dst a b => some { s with
      predicates := fun r => if r = dst then decide ((a.read id s).toNat < (b.read id s).toNat)
        else s.predicates r
      pc := s.pc + 1 }
  | .branchIf predicate target => some { s with
      pc := if s.predicates predicate then target else s.pc + 1 }
  | .addF32RN dst a b => ops.map (fun op =>
      s.write dst (op.addRN (a.read id s) (b.read id s)))
  | .maxPositiveZero dst src => some (s.write dst (FP32.maxPositiveZero (src.read id s)))
  | .storeF32 address src => some { s with
      globalMemory := fun a => if a = address.read s then some (src.read id s) else s.globalMemory a
      pc := s.pc + 1 }
  | .ret => some { s with returned := true, pc := s.pc + 1 }

/-- Active threads fetch at the current PC; returned threads have no next step. -/
def step [DecidableEq Reg] (program : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity)
    (s : State Reg) (env : Environment := Environment.empty)
    (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic := none) : Option (State Reg) :=
  if s.returned then none else
    (program[s.pc]?).bind (fun inst => inst.execute id s env ops)

/-- Execute exactly `fuel` instructions; failed fetches and excluded instruction uses yield `none`. -/
def run [DecidableEq Reg] (program : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : State Reg) (env : Environment := Environment.empty)
    (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic := none) : Option (State Reg) :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => some s
  | fuel + 1 => (step program id s env ops).bind (fun next => run program id fuel next env ops)

theorem run_add [DecidableEq Reg] (program : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity)
    (a b : Nat) (s : State Reg) (env : Environment) (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic) :
    run program id (a + b) s env ops =
      (run program id a s env ops).bind (fun next => run program id b next env ops) := by
  induction a generalizing s with
  | zero => simp [run]
  | succ a ih => simp [Nat.succ_add, run, ih, Option.bind_assoc]

private theorem step_append_of_step [DecidableEq Reg]
    (program suffix : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity) (s next : State Reg)
    (env : Environment) (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic)
    (h : step program id s env ops = some next) :
    step (program ++ suffix) id s env ops = some next := by
  have hpc : s.pc < program.length := by
    by_contra hn
    have hf := List.getElem?_eq_none (l := program) (by omega : program.length ≤ s.pc)
    simp [step, hf] at h
  simpa only [step, List.getElem?_append_left hpc] using h

/-- Appending instructions cannot change an already successful prefix execution. -/
theorem run_append_of_run [DecidableEq Reg]
    (program suffix : List (Instruction Reg)) (id : Identity) (fuel : Nat)
    (s final : State Reg) (env : Environment) (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic)
    (h : run program id fuel s env ops = some final) :
    run (program ++ suffix) id fuel s env ops = some final := by
  induction fuel generalizing s with
  | zero => simpa [run] using h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    obtain ⟨next, hs, ht⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
    have he := step_append_of_step program suffix id s next env ops hs
    simpa only [run, he, Option.bind_some] using ih next ht

/-- Register names shared by all selected kernel blocks. -/
inductive Register where
  | thread | block | row
  | weightBase | inputRead | biasBase | outputBase
  | rowOffset | elementOffset | weightRead | biasRead | outputWrite
  | column | weightValue | inputValue | accumulator | more
  | biasValue | result
  deriving DecidableEq

def Register.ptxName : Register → String
  | .thread => "%thread"
  | .block => "%block"
  | .row => "%row"
  | .weightBase => "%W_base"
  | .inputRead => "%x_read"
  | .biasBase => "%b_base"
  | .outputBase => "%y_base"
  | .rowOffset => "%row_offset"
  | .elementOffset => "%element_offset"
  | .weightRead => "%W_read"
  | .biasRead => "%b_read"
  | .outputWrite => "%y_write"
  | .column => "%j"
  | .weightValue => "%w"
  | .inputValue => "%x"
  | .accumulator => "%acc"
  | .more => "%more"
  | .biasValue => "%bias"
  | .result => "%result"

private def operandText : Operand Register → String
  | .reg r => r.ptxName
  | .imm v => toString v.toNat
  | .tidX => "%tid.x"
  | .ctaidX => "%ctaid.x"

private def operand64Text : Operand64 Register → String
  | .reg r => r.ptxName
  | .imm v => toString v.toNat

/-- Render the selected instruction forms for executable source-fragment comparisons. -/
def Instruction.ptxText : Instruction Register → String
  | .mov dst src => s!"mov.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText src};"
  | .madLo dst a b c =>
      s!"mad.lo.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b}, {operandText c};"
  | .mulWide dst a b => s!"mul.wide.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .add64 dst a b => s!"add.u64 {dst.ptxName}, {operand64Text a}, {operand64Text b};"
  | .ldParam64 dst symbol => s!"ld.param.u64 {dst.ptxName}, [{symbol}];"
  | .cvtaGlobal64 dst src => s!"cvta.to.global.u64 {dst.ptxName}, {operand64Text src};"
  | .movF32 dst value =>
      let digits := Nat.toDigits 16 value.toNat
      s!"mov.f32 {dst.ptxName}, 0f{String.ofList (List.replicate (8 - digits.length) '0' ++ digits)};"
  | .loadF32 dst address => s!"ld.global.f32 {dst.ptxName}, [{operand64Text address}];"
  | .fmaRN dst a b c => s!"fma.rn.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b}, {operandText c};"
  | .add32 dst a b => s!"add.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .setpLt dst a b => s!"setp.lt.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .branchIf predicate target => s!"@{predicate.ptxName} bra PC_{target};"
  | .addF32RN dst a b => s!"add.rn.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .maxPositiveZero dst src => s!"max.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText src}, 0f00000000;"
  | .storeF32 address src => s!"st.global.f32 [{operand64Text address}], {operandText src};"
  | .ret => "ret;"

/-- Returning from the selected kernel entry thread prevents another instruction step. -/
theorem step_after_return (program : List (Instruction Reg)) [DecidableEq Reg]
    (id : Identity) (s : State Reg) (env : Environment) (ops : Option FP32.Arithmetic)
    (hreturned : s.returned = true) : step program id s env ops = none := by
  simp [step, hreturned]

private def expectedSource : String :=

def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let source ← IO.FS.readFile (args.headD "kernels/relu_layer.ptx")

    (fun line => !line.isEmpty && !(line.startsWith "//"))

    throw (IO.userError s!"Expected exactly one bias/ReLU/store/return suffix:\n{expectedSource}")
